::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
NXP's India centres are among its largest globally. Bengaluru is a key hub for automotive processor and secure element design.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Automotive application processors (S32 family), secure NFC controllers, i.MX application processors, and radar sensor ICs for ADAS.
